summary: Completed frontend testing of Quick Wing Fleet Management App - My Bookings Tab and Booking Conflict Alert features. All 7 test cases passed (100%). Both features work correctly for staff and admin users.
passed_tests: My Bookings tab - clicking filters calendar to only show logged-in user's bookings (staff: 33 bookings, admin: 8 bookings)
My Bookings tab - displays count of user's bookings in badge (verified for both staff and admin)
My Bookings tab - calendar header changes to indigo/purple (bg-indigo-600) and shows '👤 My Bookings' text
My Bookings tab - shows user email in calendar header (staff@quickwing.com / admin@quickwing.com)
All Bookings tab - shows all bookings when selected (header changes back to blue bg-blue-600)
Booking Conflict Alert - appears when selecting car and time that overlaps with existing booking
Booking Conflict Alert - shows car name (Hyundai i30 (M)), conflicting user (Weekly Staff), time (09:00 - 17:00), and status (Pending badge)
Booking Conflict Alert - disappears when selecting non-conflicting time (changed from Feb 16 to Feb 20)
critical_code_review_comments: Code implementation is clean and follows React best practices
viewMode state properly toggles between 'all' and 'my' views
getBookingsForDate function correctly filters by created_by_email when viewMode is 'my'
checkBookingConflicts function properly detects overlapping bookings with debounce (300ms)
Conflict warning UI is well-designed with clear information display
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing bookings
context_for_next_testing_agent: My Bookings tab and Booking Conflict Alert features are fully functional. The viewMode toggle (data-testid='view-mode-toggle') switches between 'all' and 'my' views. My Bookings tab (data-testid='my-bookings-tab') shows user's booking count in badge. Calendar header changes to indigo (bg-indigo-600) when My Bookings is selected. Conflict warning (data-testid='conflict-warning') appears when booking form has overlapping time with existing bookings.
